description: Creates a new hyperlink object to be used for setting hyperlinks on drawing objects (shapes or images).

params.description: The hyperlink address. Accepts an external URL (http, https, mailto, ftp) or one of the internal slide actions: "ppaction://hlinkshowjump?jump=firstslide", "ppaction://hlinkshowjump?jump=lastslide", "ppaction://hlinkshowjump?jump=nextslide", "ppaction://hlinkshowjump?jump=previousslide", "ppaction://hlinksldjumpslide{N}" (N is the zero-based slide index), "ppaction://hlinkfile?file={path}" (opens an external file).
params.name: link
